zh.title: Discovery紀錄片首度深入華航修護廠 揭飛安關鍵
zh.summary: 華航修護廠紀錄片；飛安體系；人才培育
body: Discovery頻道新紀錄片「工程先鋒：飛航守護者」首度深入中華航空修護工廠，涵蓋從拆卸、檢查、維護、回裝到測試的流程與層層作業驗證，呈現華航的維修與飛安體系、人才培育與安全文化。
紀錄片今天在記者會公開精彩片段，華航董事長高星潢與總經理陳漢銘出席觀影。影片也深入華航24小時修管中心，呈現地面團隊如何即時監控機隊運行。
華航修護訓練中心運用MR（混合實境）與模擬教學設備培育修護人才。高星潢表示，「錢可以借，專業設備可以買，但人是培養出來，達到為永續經營的關鍵」。

en.title: Discovery Documentary Goes Behind the Scenes at China Airlines' MRO Facility
en.summary: Discovery documentary tours China Airline Maintenance MRO; safety culture; MR training
body: Discovery Channel's new documentary "Engineering Pioneers: Aviation Guardians" offers an in-depth look at China Airlines' maintenance factory, covering the process of disassembly, inspection, reinstallation and testing with layered verification to reveal the carrier's maintenance and flight safety system, talent development, and safety culture.

Highlights were shown at a press conference attended by Chairman Kao Shing-Huang and General Manager Chen Han-Ming. The documentary also features the carrier's 24-hour maintenance monitoring center and its ground team's real-time fleet monitoring.

The maintenance training center uses Mixed Reality (MR) and simulation equipment to train new maintenance personnel. Kao said money and equipment can be borrowed or bought, but people must be cultivated and are the key to sustainable operations.

zh.title: 西班牙空天軍選定A321為SIGINT載臺 正式公告尚待發布
zh.summary: 西班牙空天軍選定空中巴士A321為SIGINT載臺；尚未有正式公告。
body: 西班牙空天軍已選定空中巴士A321作為其未來載人信號情報（SIGINT）飛機的載臺。
根據西班牙空天軍官方雜誌《Revista de Aeronáutica y Astronáutica》一篇關於空中預警（AEW）能力的文章表示，潛在的國家AEW解決方案可能以空中巴士平臺為基礎，「因為已選定A321用於其SIGINT計畫（Santiago II-SCAPA），因此有可能將此計畫擴展至國家AEW解決方案。」
截至2026年10月6日，西班牙國防部、空中巴士或Indra皆尚未就選定A321一事做出正式公告。
此機型預期會在「Santiago II-SCAPA」計畫下啟動的定義研究中脫穎而出。西班牙部長會議已於2025年11月18日授權該研究合約，估計價值為1600萬歐元，自正式化後為期18個月。空中巴士亦已於2025年12月30日宣佈，其與Indra已獲選來決定「最適合的平臺」及SIGINT設備，以組成包含三架飛機的西班牙主權方案。
該計畫的載人飛機組成部分分為兩個階段。第一階段涵蓋評估可行飛機並研究SIGINT系統如何整合，但不開發硬體。第二階段則要求在架三架飛機上實施SIGINT能力。
報導同時指出，其參考意味著為Santiago II-SCAPE選擇A321可能創造機會，以在相同平臺及工業基礎之上發展國家AEW組態；然而此類AEW計畫尚未正式啟動。

en.title: Spanish Air Force selects Airbus A321 for future SIGINT fleet; no official announcement yet
en.summary: Spanish Air Force picks Airbus A as SIGINT platform per service magazine; no official announcement yet.
body: The Spanish Air and Space Force has chosen the Airbus A321 as the platform for its future crewed signals intelligence (SIGINT) aircraft.

According to an article on airborne early warning (AEW) capabilities in the Revista de Aeronáutica y Astronáutica, the service's official magazine, a potential national AEW solution would likely be based on an Airbus platform, "since, having chosen the A321 for its SIGINT program (Santiago II-SCAPA), there would be the possibility of extending this program to a national AEW solution."
As of October 6, 2026, no formal announcement has been made by Spain's Ministry of Defense, Airbus, or Indra regarding the selection of the A321.

The aircraft type was expected to emerge from a definition study launched under the Santiago II-SCAPA program. Spain's Council of Ministers authorized the study contract on November 18, 2025, with an estimated value of €16 million and a duration of 18 months from formalization. Airbus announced on December 30, 2025, that it and Indra had been selected to determine "the most suitable platform" and SIGINT equipment for a sovereign Spanish solution comprising three aircraft.

The crewed aircraft component of the program is divided into two phases. The first covers assessing viable aircraft and studying the integration of SIGINT systems, without developing hardware. The second phase calls for implementing the SIGINT capability on three aircraft.

The magazine's reference indicates that choosing the A321 for Santiago II-SCAPA could create an opportunity to develop a national AEW configuration around the same platform and industrial base, although no separate AEW program has been formally launched.
